from __future__ import annotations

import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, datetime
from enum import Enum
from pathlib import Path

DEFAULT_DB_PATH = Path.home() / ".todo-cli" / "todos.db"

_UNSET = object()


class Priority(Enum):
    HIGH = "high"
    MEDIUM = "medium"
    LOW = "low"


@dataclass
class Todo:
    id: int
    title: str
    priority: Priority
    due_date: date | None
    done: bool
    created_at: datetime


def get_connection(db_path: Path = DEFAULT_DB_PATH) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(db_path))
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    _init_schema(conn)
    return conn


def _init_schema(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS todos (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            title TEXT NOT NULL,
            priority TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
            due_date TEXT,
            done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
        )
    """)
    conn.commit()


def _row_to_todo(row: tuple) -> Todo:
    return Todo(
        id=row[0],
        title=row[1],
        priority=Priority(row[2]),
        due_date=date.fromisoformat(row[3]) if row[3] else None,
        done=bool(row[4]),
        created_at=datetime.fromisoformat(row[5]),
    )


def add_todo(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    title: str,
    priority: Priority = Priority.MEDIUM,
    due_date: date | None = None,
) -> Todo:
    cursor = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO todos (title, priority, due_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (title, priority.value, due_date.isoformat() if due_date else None),
    )
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (cursor.lastrowid,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_todo(row)


def list_todos(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    *,
    show_done: bool = False,
    priority: Priority | None = None,
    due: str | None = None,
) -> list[Todo]:
    clauses: list[str] = []
    params: list[object] = []
    if not show_done:
        clauses.append("done = 0")
    if priority is not None:
        clauses.append("priority = ?")
        params.append(priority.value)
    if due == "overdue":
        clauses.append("due_date < date('now') AND done = 0")
    elif due == "today":
        clauses.append("due_date = date('now')")
    elif due == "week":
        clauses.append("due_date BETWEEN date('now') AND date('now', '+7 days')")
    where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT * FROM todos {where} ORDER BY done, due_date IS NULL, due_date, id",
        params,
    ).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_todo(row) for row in rows]


def mark_done(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> Todo | None:
    conn.execute("UPDATE todos SET done = 1 WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,))
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_todo(row)


def update_todo(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    todo_id: int,
    *,
    title: str | None = None,
    priority: Priority | None = None,
    due_date: date | None = _UNSET,
) -> Todo | None:
    fields: list[str] = []
    values: list[object] = []
    if title is not None:
        fields.append("title = ?")
        values.append(title)
    if priority is not None:
        fields.append("priority = ?")
        values.append(priority.value)
    if due_date is not _UNSET:
        fields.append("due_date = ?")
        values.append(due_date.isoformat() if due_date else None)
    if not fields:
        row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
        return _row_to_todo(row) if row else None
    values.append(todo_id)
    conn.execute(f"UPDATE todos SET {', '.join(fields)} WHERE id = ?", values)
    conn.commit()
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_todo(row) if row else None


def delete_todo(conn: sqlite3.Connection, todo_id: int) -> bool:
    cursor = conn.execute("DELETE FROM todos WHERE id = ?", (todo_id,))
    conn.commit()
    return cursor.rowcount > 0
